svg.title: Clicks arriving out of order, the watermark, and the 10:00 window firing
svg.desc: Seven clicks in arrival order with click times 0:52, 0:58, 1:03, 0:57, 1:08, 1:12, 0:59 seconds past 10:00. Watermark is the latest click time minus 10 seconds: 0:42, 0:48, 0:53, 0:53, 0:58, 1:02, 1:02. The 10:00 window fires after the sixth click with 3 clicks; the seventh click, 0:59, is late.
svg.text: the 10:00 window: when is it safe to count?
times are past 10:00; watermark = latest click time − 10 s
#7 at 0:59 arrives after the window was written: late
